text.value:
IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM sys.tables
    WHERE name = '@{pipeline().parameters.watermarktablename}'
      AND schema_id = SCHEMA_ID('@{pipeline().parameters.schemaname}')
)
BEGIN
    CREATE TABLE [@{pipeline().parameters.schemaname}].[@{pipeline().parameters.watermarktablename}] (
        tablename     VARCHAR(30)  NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
        last_updated  DATETIME    NOT NULL
    );
END

IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [@{pipeline().parameters.schemaname}].[@{pipeline().parameters.watermarktablename}] WHERE tablename = '@{item().TableName}') INSERT INTO [@{pipeline().parameters.schemaname}].[@{pipeline().parameters.watermarktablename}] (tablename, last_updated) VALUES ('@{item().TableName}', DATEADD(DAY, -@{pipeline().parameters.initial_lookback_days}, SYSUTCDATETIME()))

sqlReaderQuery.value: SELECT last_updated as watermark_value FROM [@{pipeline().parameters.schemaname}].[@{pipeline().parameters.watermarktablename}] WHERE tablename = '@{item().TableName}'

activities.name: Copy data from source to target sql

sqlReaderQuery.value: SELECT * FROM @{item().TableSchemaName}.@{item().TableName} WHERE @{item().WaterMark_Column} >= '@{formatDateTime(if(equals(activity('Lookup to get watermark value').output.firstRow.watermark_value, null), addDays(utcNow(), sub(0, pipeline().parameters.initial_lookback_days)), activity('Lookup to get watermark value').output.firstRow.watermark_value), 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss')}' AND @{item().WaterMark_Column} <= '@{formatDateTime(activity('Lookup to get latest data').output.firstRow.NewWatermarkValue, 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss')}'
